jobs.title: Head of Finance
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE:

Founded in 2013, Ignition is the leading revenue and billing automation platform for firms and agencies. We automate proposals, invoicing, payments and workflows in a single AI-powered platform, empowering businesses to sell, bill and get paid faster.

Ignition automates proposals, engagement letters, invoicing, payments and workflows in a single AI-powered platform, empowering 8,500+ businesses to sell, bill and get paid for their services with ease. 

To date, Ignition customers have managed relationships with over 2.4 million clients and earned $13b in revenue via the platform. Ignition's global workforce spans Australia, Canada, New Zealand, the Philippines, US and the UK.




COMPANY VALUES:

 - We are better everyday

 - We work without ego

 - We are smarter together

 - We hero our customer


WHERE AND HOW WE WORK:

We are open to candidates based in Sydney or Melbourne with full Australian work rights. We operate in a hybrid model, giving you flexibility to work from home, a shared workspace, or a combination of both.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We’re looking for a strategic and hands on Head of Finance to lead our finance function at the intersection of SaaS, AI, payments, and embedded fintech.

This role is ideal for a finance leader who understands the demands of scaling a recurring revenue business while navigating the added complexity of billing infrastructure, payment flows, revenue recognition, cash management, and financial systems. You’ll own the finance foundation of the business while helping drive smarter planning, stronger economics, and more scalable operations.

As a key partner to the CFO and executive team, you’ll help turn financial data into decision making advantage, building a finance function that is rigorous, modern, and growth ready.




WHAT YOUR DAY TO DAY WILL LOOK LIKE:

Lead the Finance Function

 - Lead and develop a high performing finance team across accounting, FP&A, billing, treasury, and finance operations

 - Build strong operating rhythms, clear accountability, and scalable team structures

 - Foster a culture of accountability, continuous learning, and operational excellence, empowering the team to grow and take ownership

 - Build organizational capability by attracting top talent, developing future leaders, and creating scalable team structures

 - Partner closely with the CFO and cross functional leaders on company priorities and execution

 - Champion cross functional collaboration and lead through change in a fast growing, technology driven environment

Own Financial Reporting, Control & Compliance

 - Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual close with a focus on speed, accuracy, and control

 - Ensure compliant reporting under US GAAP, IFRS, and relevant regulatory requirements

 - Strengthen internal controls, audit readiness, and governance across a growing multi entity environment

 - Deliver executive, board, and investor ready reporting

Drive Planning, Performance & Unit Economics

 - Own budgeting, forecasting, long range planning, and scenario modeling

 - Build driver based models around key SaaS and fintech metrics including ARR, NRR, gross margin, CAC, LTV, churn, cash burn, and EBITDA

 - Provide clear insight into business performance, investment tradeoffs, and growth efficiency

 - Support pricing, packaging, capital allocation, and strategic initiative planning

Oversee Billing, Revenue & Treasury

 - Oversee billing operations, collections, reconciliations, and revenue reporting

 - Ensure strong revenue recognition practices under ASC 606 and IFRS 15

 - Partner on pricing and monetization changes, especially where product and payments flows affect revenue treatment

 - Manage banking relationships, liquidity, cash positioning, and FX exposure where relevant

Build Scalable Systems & Intelligent Workflows Build an AI-Native Finance Function

 - Improve finance infrastructure, including ERP, planning systems, reporting tools, and controls

 - Drive finance automation and embed AI enabled workflows into forecasting, reconciliations, reporting, and analysis

 - Drive the adoption of AI and automation across forecasting, close, reporting, reconciliations and financial analysis while maintaining strong governance and controls

 - Partner with Engineering, Data, and Operations to improve systems integration and create a reliable financial source of truth

 - Increase efficiency by reducing manual work and strengthening process design

 - Continuously identify opportunities to simplify processes, reduce manual effort and leverage emerging technologies to create competitive advantage

Support Growth & Strategic Change

 - Contribute to M&A diligence, integration planning, and post acquisition finance execution where relevant

 - Support fundraising, investor reporting, and strategic finance projects as needed

 - Help build the financial infrastructure needed for scale in a complex SaaS + fintech environment




WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED:

 - 10+ years of progressive finance experience, including senior leadership in controllership, FP&A, or strategic finance

 - Strong experience in SaaS businesses with deep understanding of recurring revenue models and subscription metrics

 - Solid grounding in payments, billing infrastructure, or embedded fintech economics

 - Expertise in US GAAP, IFRS, and ASC 606 revenue recognition

 - Experience leading close, reporting, forecasting, and financial performance management

 - Proven ability to build teams, improve systems, and scale finance in a high growth environment

 - Strong commercial judgment, analytical capability, and executive communication skills

Bonus Points For:

 - Multi entity, multi currency, or global finance experience

 - Exposure to treasury, capital strategy, or banking operations

 - Experience with finance transformation, automation, and AI workflows

 - Experience supporting M&A, board reporting, or fundraising readiness

 - Familiarity with tools such as Xero, planning platforms, and modern reporting systems

 - Familiarity with embedded finance, payments infrastructure, or related regulatory considerations





WHO YOU ARE

 - A strong operator with excellent finance fundamentals

 - A strategic thinker who can connect numbers to business decisions

 - A builder who enjoys creating structure, improving systems, and scaling teams

 - A collaborative leader who works effectively across functions and levels

 - Comfortable in a fast paced environment where priorities evolve and impact matters
   
   


WHY JOIN US:

Join our global SaaS scale-up company where we foster a collaborative, open, and transparent culture and work without ego. Our team comprises curious and intelligent colleagues who embrace challenges. Here's what we offer:

 - Competitive salary package plus employee stock options from day one

 - Annual education allowance to support your professional development

 - Employee recognition program that celebrates impact and contribution

 - Quarterly wellness allowance to support your physical and mental wellbeing

 - Complimentary subscriptions to Headspace and our Employee Assistance Program

 - Flexible working, supported by work-from-office reimbursement and a mobile allowance to help you set up safely at home

 - Work from anywhere for up to one month each year, with business approval

 - Financial Planning allowance (after all, we are in the accounting business!)

 - Vehicle Leasing Benefits

 - Paid parental leave

 - An extra paid day off for your birthday, plus paid volunteering leave




WHAT TO EXPECT FROM OUR RECRUITMENT PROCESS:

Our recruitment process is designed to ensure a great fit for both you and Ignition. Here’s an overview of the typical steps you may experience:

 - Introductory conversation with our Talent team: A friendly discussion to learn more about your background and share additional context about the role and Ignition.

 - Hiring Manager conversation: A focused discussion on your experience, strengths, leadership approach, and alignment with our strategic priorities.

 - Functional and stakeholder interviews: Structured conversations with cross functional stakeholders to explore collaboration, culture, and how we work together.

 - Final conversation with the Head of the function: An opportunity to discuss career growth, as well as the broader business context and vision.

 - Reference and background checks: Conducted following acceptance of a verbal offer.

We may use AI enabled tools to support parts of our recruitment process, such as improving efficiency in scheduling and note taking. These tools are used responsibly and never replace human decision-making, all hiring decisions are made by our people.

We aim to keep the process transparent, respectful of your time, and as smooth as possible.

We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement, experience comes in many forms, and diverse perspectives make our teams stronger.

Ignition is an equal opportunity employer. If you require accommodations during the recruitment process or need materials in an alternative format, please contact careers@ignitionapp.com.
